title: Preserve unfinished evidence cause when an evaluator child session is missing
outcome: A missing evaluator child publishes both the missing-child outcome and the already captured unfinished-evidence infrastructure cause, without inventing a criterion verdict.
acceptance: When recovery is unfinished and the child outcome is Missing, result.summary preserves the phase/cause together with the missing-child outcome.
Unknown or retired tracker writes and active submission ownership retain their current precedence and no verdict is fabricated.
An observable terminal-publication regression covers the Missing outcome, bounded output and parent-visible result.
